name_reason: Compliant and accurate. fd2_ prefix is correct for a game function. '1a' is the dispatch index 0x1A in the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (domain ID, not address residue) and matches the file-wide sibling convention. 'ch7' is the chapter (domain ID). 'char_cond' (char-conditional) is accurate: the only branch gates on the stepping char's team. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Chapter 7 tile-step event handler (dispatch idx 0x1A): when a non-enemy unit (team != 0, i.e. npc/player) steps on the trigger tile, disarm the per-event AI/dialog control flag for chars 0x09..0x1B and consume the trigger. No dialog.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x10) stack-probe prologue (compiler-injected). Reads the stepping char id from the stack arg, indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (0x50-byte stride) and tests the team byte at +0x06. If team != 0: calls fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(9, 0x1B, 0) which writes 0 into the low nibble of combat_aux_block[0xD] for the 19 chars 0x09..0x1B (inclusive), then sets the consumed-flags byte at base+0x10 to 1 to consume the trigger. If team == 0 (enemy) the whole body is skipped. No RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used; single team-gate branch.

params.name: stepping_char_id
params.semantics: Runtime-char id of the unit that stepped onto the ch7 trigger tile (passed on the stack per the tile-step dispatch convention). Used as the index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr; its .team byte is the gate.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value (the stepping char's id) and how it is used. No address residue; not a generic param_N name.

reads_globals: data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr (0x53AD5) -- base of the 0x20-byte tile-event consumed-flags block
writes_globals: data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr[0x10] -- written 1 to consume the trigger (via the pointed-to block, not the pointer itself)
comment_original_issue: Comment body was already accurate and precise; only the header line used a non-ASCII em-dash (violates the code-ASCII-only rule).
notes: Disassembly at 0x3499b confirms: __CHK(0x10); index *0x50 into [0x53a45], read byte +0x06 (team); JZ skip when team==0; PUSH 0/0x1b/9 CALL 0x3419c (fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range); MOV [0x53ad5]+0x10 := 1. Range 0x09..0x1B inclusive = 19 chars (0x13). 0 direct callers; only DATA xref from 0x51bf9 (the handler table). Note: src struct field is .team while Ghidra decomp shows .bTeam -- same field at +0x06, clean-name vs Hungarian-prefixed; consistent, not a discrepancy (no action). Comment fix = single em-dash -> '--' on the header line; rest of block already ASCII with '--'. Ghidra plate is consistent with the source understanding (same team gate, 19-char range, slot 0x10 consume, no dialog) so left unchanged. No rename applied (Stage 2 handles renames; this is keep anyway).
